# uitive

<!-- Generated by `pnpm run docs` from packages/cli/src: edit the JSDoc there. -->

The agent kit as a command-line tool and a library: detection, set-up, sources from OpenAPI, blocks, discovery and the check.

Install: `pnpm add uitive`. Guides: [Coding agents](../coding-agents.md).

- [Running the CLI](#running-the-cli): [`run`](#run), [`RunContext`](#runcontext), [`Writable`](#writable)

## Running the CLI

Source: [`commands.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/commands.ts)

### run

Runs the CLI; returns the exit code.

```ts
function run(argv: readonly string[], context: RunContext): Promise<number>;
```

Uses: [`RunContext`](#runcontext).

### RunContext

What the CLI writes to, and the version it reports.

Uses: [`Writable`](#writable).

| Property  | Type       | Description                     |
| --------- | ---------- | ------------------------------- |
| `version` | `string`   | The version `--version` prints. |
| `out`     | `Writable` | Where results go.               |
| `err`     | `Writable` | Where problems go.              |

### Writable

Somewhere text can be written, such as `process.stdout`.

| Property  | Type                        | Description      |
| --------- | --------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `write()` | `(text: string) => unknown` | Writes the text. |

## Setting up

Source: [`detect.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/detect.ts), [`folder.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/folder.ts), [`init.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/init.ts), [`templates.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/templates.ts)

### detect

What a project uses: everything `init` needs to set Uitive up to fit.

```ts
function detect(cwd?: string): Promise<Detection>;
```

Uses: [`Detection`](#detection).

### detectText

A detection as text, one line per finding.

```ts
function detectText(found: Detection): string;
```

Uses: [`Detection`](#detection).

### FOLDER

Where Uitive's files go unless the project says otherwise.

```ts
const FOLDER = 'uitive';
```

### folderOf

Where a project keeps Uitive's files: `uitive.dir` in its package.json, which
`init --dir` writes, else `uitive`. Relative to the project, with forward slashes.

```ts
function folderOf(cwd: string): Promise<string>;
```

### init

Sets Uitive up in a project: packages, a folder (`src/uitive/` or `uitive/`)
whose contract starts with every page as a region, sources generated from an API description
when one is small enough, and the coding agents' MCP servers and skill, at the repository's
root. Never overwrites a file.

```ts
function init(options?: InitOptions): Promise<InitResult>;
```

Uses: [`InitOptions`](#initoptions), [`InitResult`](#initresult).

### initText

What `init` did, as text: the files, the install and the next steps.

```ts
function initText(result: InitResult): string;
```

Uses: [`InitResult`](#initresult).

### SKILL

The integration playbook for coding agents, as `init` installs it: the same text as the Claude
Code plugin's skill.

```ts
const SKILL: string;
```

### Detected

Something detection found, such as a framework, with its version.

| Property   | Type     | Description                          |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `name`     | `string` | The package or tool, such as `next`. |
| `version?` | `string` | Its version, when the manifest says. |

### Detection

What a project uses: its package manager, interface, framework, router, design systems, API
descriptions, coding agents and workspace.

Uses: [`Detected`](#detected).

| Property            | Type                                                                                  | Description                                                                     |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `root`              | `string`                                                                              | The package's folder, where Uitive is set up.                                   |
| `name`              | `string`                                                                              | The package's name.                                                             |
| `packageManager`    | `'pnpm' \| 'yarn' \| 'npm' \| 'bun'`                                                  | The package manager its lockfile shows.                                         |
| `typescript`        | `boolean`                                                                             | Whether it uses TypeScript.                                                     |
| `ui`                | `Detected \| null`                                                                    | Its interface library, such as React.                                           |
| `framework`         | `Detected \| null`                                                                    | Its framework, such as Next.js or Vite.                                         |
| `router`            | `Detected \| null`                                                                    | Its router, such as React Router.                                               |
| `designSystems`     | `Detected[]`                                                                          | Component libraries and styling, such as `@medusajs/ui` or `shadcn`.            |
| `openapi`           | `string[]`                                                                            | API descriptions found in the project, relative to its root.                    |
| `agents`            | `('claude-code' \| 'cursor' \| 'vscode' \| 'codex')[]`                                | Coding agents the project is set up for, so `init` can configure them.          |
| `uitive`            | `boolean`                                                                             | Whether Uitive is already set up.                                               |
| `packageManagerPin` | `string \| null`                                                                      | The pinned package manager, such as `yarn@1.22.22`, from `packageManager`.      |
| `repository`        | `string`                                                                              | The repository's root, where coding agents run: the nearest folder with `.git`. |
| `workspaces`        | `{ path: string; name: string; ui: Detected \| null; framework: Detected \| null }[]` | For a workspace root: its packages with an interface, where Uitive belongs.     |
| `server`            | `boolean`                                                                             | Whether the application has its own server, where the model planner can run.    |

### InitOptions

What `init` takes: the project, where its files go, the API description, and how to install.

| Property    | Type      | Default                                                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `cwd?`      | `string`  | `process.cwd()`                                                                  | The project's root.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `openapi?`  | `string`  |                                                                                  | The API description to generate from; else the first one found.                                                                                                                      |
| `install?`  | `boolean` | `true`                                                                           | Installs the packages with the project's package manager.                                                                                                                            |
| `agents?`   | `boolean` | `true`                                                                           | Configures the coding agents found: MCP servers and the integration skill.                                                                                                           |
| `mcp?`      | `string`  | 'npx -y                                                                          | How agents start the MCP server.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `packages?` | `string`  |                                                                                  | A folder of package tarballs (`pnpm pack`) to install from, such as a local build.                                                                                                   |
| `dir?`      | `string`  | the recorded folder, else 'src/uitive' when there is a src folder, else 'uitive' | Where Uitive's files go, relative to the project, such as `app/uitive` for a build that compiles only `app`. Recorded in package.json as `uitive.dir`, where every command reads it. |

### InitResult

What `init` did: what it detected, the files it wrote and kept, the install, and what to do next.

Uses: [`Detection`](#detection).

| Property    | Type                                                               | Description                                           |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `detection` | `Detection`                                                        | What the project uses.                                |
| `written`   | `string[]`                                                         | Files written, relative to the project.               |
| `kept`      | `string[]`                                                         | Files that existed and were left alone.               |
| `install`   | `{ command: string; ran: boolean; ok?: boolean; output?: string }` | The install command, whether it ran, and how it went. |
| `next`      | `string[]`                                                         | What to do next, in order.                            |

## API descriptions

Source: [`curation.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/curation.ts), [`emit.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/emit.ts), [`generate.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/generate.ts), [`openapi.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/openapi.ts), [`survey.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/survey.ts)

### curate

Applies a curation: keeps the sources it chooses and their actions, and its overrides. Effects
may be raised freely and lowered only with a stated reason. Problems name every reference that
doesn't resolve, so a typo never passes silently.

```ts
function curate(
  inventory: ApiInventory,
  curation: Curation,
): {
  inventory: ApiInventory;
  problems: string[];
};
```

Uses: [`ApiInventory`](#apiinventory), [`Curation`](#curation-type).

### CURATE_ACTIONS

Actions past which models choose worse: curate down to what the interface offers.

```ts
const CURATE_ACTIONS = 200;
```

### CURATE_SOURCES

Past these, models choose worse: curate down to what the frontend shows.

```ts
const CURATE_SOURCES = 40;
```

### CURATION

Where the curation is, in a project that keeps Uitive's files in `uitive/`; commands use the project's own folder (`folderOf`).

```ts
const CURATION = 'uitive/curation.json';
```

### curationSchema

`uitive/curation.json`: what to keep from an API description, kept across regenerations.

```ts
const curationSchema: ZodObject;
```

### emit

The generated module: sources, actions and how each maps to the API.

```ts
function emit(inventory: ApiInventory, options: EmitOptions): string;
```

Uses: [`ApiInventory`](#apiinventory), [`EmitOptions`](#emitoptions).

### GENERATED

Where `generate sources` writes, in a project that keeps Uitive's files in `uitive/`; commands use the project's own folder (`folderOf`).

```ts
const GENERATED = 'uitive/api.generated.ts';
```

### generateSources

Generates sources, actions and endpoints from an API description and its curation.

```ts
function generateSources(options: GenerateSourcesOptions): Promise<
  GenerateSourcesResult & {
    code: string;
  }
>;
```

Uses: [`GenerateSourcesOptions`](#generatesourcesoptions), [`GenerateSourcesResult`](#generatesourcesresult).

### inventory

Builds the inventory: every list endpoint a source, every write an action.

```ts
function inventory(doc: Record<string, unknown>, options?: InventoryOptions): ApiInventory;
```

Uses: [`ApiInventory`](#apiinventory), [`InventoryOptions`](#inventoryoptions).

### kebab

A name in kebab case, as IDs are written: `OrderItems` gives `order-items`.

```ts
function kebab(value: string): string;
```

### parseCuration

Reads a curation, or names every problem with it, such as a key that doesn't exist.

```ts
function parseCuration(value: unknown):
  | {
      curation: Curation;
    }
  | {
      problems: string[];
    };
```

Uses: [`Curation`](#curation-type).

### picksOf

The picks a curation asks for, by source, for `inventory`.

```ts
function picksOf(curation: Curation): Record<string, Record<string, string>>;
```

Uses: [`Curation`](#curation-type).

### plain

Plain text from a description: no HTML or Markdown, whole sentences, at most `length` characters.

```ts
function plain(value: string, length?: number): string;
```

### readSpec

Reads an OpenAPI 2.0, 3.0 or 3.1 document, JSON or YAML, as OpenAPI 3.1.

```ts
function readSpec(source: string | Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown>;
```

### singular

An English word in the singular, as source IDs need for relations: `orders` gives `order`.

```ts
function singular(word: string): string;
```

### survey

Surveys what the mapper read, marking the sources a curation keeps.

```ts
function survey(inventory: ApiInventory, included?: ReadonlySet<string>): Survey;
```

Uses: [`ApiInventory`](#apiinventory), [`Survey`](#survey-type).

### surveySpec

A compact inventory of an API description, marking what the curation keeps.

```ts
function surveySpec(options: SpecOptions): Promise<
  Survey & {
    problems: string[];
  }
>;
```

Uses: [`SpecOptions`](#specoptions), [`Survey`](#survey-type).

### surveyText

The survey as text: one line per source, sized for a coding agent's context.

```ts
function surveyText(value: Survey): string;
```

Uses: [`Survey`](#survey-type).

### ApiAction

One action the mapper read from an API description: its params, effect, and REST endpoint.

Uses: [`ApiParam`](#apiparam), [`Effect`](core.md#effect), [`Op`](core.md#op), [`RestAction`](core.md#restaction), [`Skipped`](#skipped).

| Property      | Type                                            | Description                                                      |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`          | `string`                                        | The action's ID, which the curation uses.                        |
| `label`       | `string`                                        | What people call it.                                             |
| `description` | `string`                                        | What it does, for people and models.                             |
| `operation`   | `string`                                        | The operation it runs, such as `POST /v1/refunds`.               |
| `resource`    | `string \| null`                                | The source the action works on, when there is one.               |
| `effect`      | `Effect`                                        | What a run does to data: `read`, `write` or `destructive`.       |
| `reason`      | `string`                                        | Why the effect was chosen.                                       |
| `params`      | `ApiParam[]`                                    | What a run takes, besides the path's own params.                 |
| `skipped`     | `Skipped[]`                                     | Params left out, and why.                                        |
| `invalidates` | `string[]`                                      | Sources a run changes, so results that read them refresh.        |
| `rest`        | `RestAction`                                    | How `restPerform` runs it.                                       |
| `confirm?`    | `string`                                        | For destructive actions: the phrase a run asks for.              |
| `when?`       | `{ field: string; op: Op; values: string[] }[]` | Qualified filters on the row's source, such as `charges.status`. |

### ApiField

One field of an API's rows, as the mapper reads it: its type, meaning and where it is in a row.

Uses: [`FieldType`](core.md#fieldtype).

| Property      | Type                   | Description                                                                       |
| ------------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`        | `string`               | The field's name in the contract.                                                 |
| `type`        | `FieldType`            | What the value means, which decides how it shows and filters.                     |
| `nullable`    | `boolean`              | Whether rows may lack a value.                                                    |
| `description` | `string`               | What the field holds, from the API description.                                   |
| `values`      | `string[]`             | For enums.                                                                        |
| `unit?`       | `'iso' \| 's' \| 'ms'` | For times: an ISO string, or seconds or milliseconds since 1970.                  |
| `currency?`   | `string`               | For money: the field holding the currency.                                        |
| `minor?`      | `boolean`              | For money: whether amounts are in minor units, such as cents.                     |
| `source?`     | `string`               | For refs: the source referred to.                                                 |
| `pointer?`    | `string`               | For a value lifted from a nested object or renamed: where it is in a row.         |
| `label?`      | `string`               | What people call it, when its name doesn't say, such as "Order" for `display_id`. |

### ApiInventory

Everything the mapper read from an API description: sources, actions, and what it skipped.

Uses: [`ApiAction`](#apiaction), [`ApiSource`](#apisource).

| Property  | Type                                      | Description                              |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `title`   | `string`                                  | The API's title, from its description.   |
| `version` | `string`                                  | The API's version, from its description. |
| `server`  | `string`                                  | The base URL requests go to.             |
| `sources` | `ApiSource[]`                             | Every source read.                       |
| `actions` | `ApiAction[]`                             | Every action read.                       |
| `skipped` | `{ operation: string; reason: string }[]` | Operations that became neither, and why. |

### ApiParam

One param of an action, as the mapper reads it.

| Property      | Type                   | Description                                                                       |
| ------------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `required`    | `boolean`              | Whether a run needs it.                                                           |
| `name`        | `string`               | The field's name in the contract.                                                 |
| `type`        | `FieldType`            | What the value means, which decides how it shows and filters.                     |
| `nullable`    | `boolean`              | Whether rows may lack a value.                                                    |
| `description` | `string`               | What the field holds, from the API description.                                   |
| `values`      | `string[]`             | For enums.                                                                        |
| `unit?`       | `'iso' \| 's' \| 'ms'` | For times: an ISO string, or seconds or milliseconds since 1970.                  |
| `currency?`   | `string`               | For money: the field holding the currency.                                        |
| `minor?`      | `boolean`              | For money: whether amounts are in minor units, such as cents.                     |
| `source?`     | `string`               | For refs: the source referred to.                                                 |
| `pointer?`    | `string`               | For a value lifted from a nested object or renamed: where it is in a row.         |
| `label?`      | `string`               | What people call it, when its name doesn't say, such as "Order" for `display_id`. |

### ApiSource

One source the mapper read from an API description: its fields, capabilities and REST endpoint.

```ts
interface ApiSource {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  keywords: string[];
  schema: string;
  operation: string;
  key: string;
  title: string;
  summary: string[];
  fields: ApiField[];
  extra: ApiField[];
  skipped: Skipped[];
  capabilities: {
    filter: Record<string, Op[]>;
    sort: string[];
    search: boolean;
    pagination: 'cursor' | 'offset' | 'none';
  };
  rest: RestSource;
  notes: string[];
  scan?: number;
  ttl?: number;
}
```

Uses: [`ApiField`](#apifield), [`Op`](core.md#op), [`RestSource`](core.md#restsource), [`Skipped`](#skipped).

| Property       | Description                                                                                |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`           | The source's ID, which the curation uses.                                                  |
| `label`        | What people call it.                                                                       |
| `description`  | What its rows are, for people and models.                                                  |
| `keywords`     | Other words people use for it, so requests find it.                                        |
| `schema`       | The row schema's component name, when it has one.                                          |
| `operation`    | The operation that lists its rows, such as `GET /v1/charges`.                              |
| `key`          | The field that identifies a row.                                                           |
| `title`        | The field that names a row.                                                                |
| `summary`      | The fields that sum a row up.                                                              |
| `fields`       | The fields kept.                                                                           |
| `extra`        | Fields understood but left out to keep the source small; the curation can bring them back. |
| `skipped`      | Fields left out, and why.                                                                  |
| `capabilities` | What the endpoint does by itself: filters by field, sorting, search and paging.            |
| `rest`         | How `restFetch` reads it.                                                                  |
| `notes`        | Guesses worth checking against the running API.                                            |
| `scan?`        | Most rows fetched to answer one query on the client, when the curation sets it.            |
| `ttl?`         | Seconds a result stays fresh, when the curation sets it.                                   |

### Curation type

A curation, read: what to keep from an API description, with defaults filled in.

```ts
type Curation = z.infer<typeof curationSchema>;
```

Uses: [`curationSchema`](#curationschema).

### CurationInput

A curation as written in `curation.json`.

```ts
type CurationInput = z.input<typeof curationSchema>;
```

Uses: [`curationSchema`](#curationschema).

### EmitOptions

How generated sources are written: where the description came from, and which modules the code
imports.

| Property    | Type     | Default                  | Description                                                             |
| ----------- | -------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `from`      | `string` |                          | Where the description came from, for the header, such as `stripe.json`. |
| `core?`     | `string` | `'@plurid/uitive-core'`  | The module that exports the field helpers.                              |
| `zod?`      | `string` | `'zod'`                  | The module that exports `z`.                                            |
| `curation?` | `string` | `'uitive/curation.json'` | The curation file, named in the header.                                 |

### GenerateSourcesOptions

What `generate sources` takes: the description, its curation, and where to write.

| Property    | Type      | Default                                           | Description                                              |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `out?`      | `string`  | 'api.generated.ts' in the project's Uitive folder | Where to write.                                          |
| `dryRun?`   | `boolean` | `false`                                           | Reports without writing.                                 |
| `spec`      | `string`  |                                                   | A path or URL to an OpenAPI 2.0, 3.0 or 3.1 description. |
| `cwd?`      | `string`  | `process.cwd()`                                   | The project's root.                                      |
| `curation?` | `string`  | 'curation.json' in the project's Uitive folder    | The curation file; used when it exists.                  |

### GenerateSourcesResult

What `generate sources` did: the file, whether it was written, the sources and actions, and what
stopped it.

| Property   | Type       | Description                                                             |
| ---------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `file`     | `string`   | The generated module.                                                   |
| `written`  | `boolean`  | Whether it was written; not on a dry run, or when something blocked it. |
| `sources`  | `string[]` | The IDs of the sources generated.                                       |
| `actions`  | `string[]` | The IDs of the actions generated.                                       |
| `problems` | `string[]` | What blocks generation: fix these first.                                |
| `notes`    | `string[]` | Guesses worth checking.                                                 |

### InventoryOptions

How the mapper reads a description: which nested values to lift into fields.

| Property | Type                                                         | Description                                                                        |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `picks?` | `Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, string>>>>` | Values lifted from nested objects, by source: field name to JSON pointer in a row. |

### Skipped

Something the mapper left out, and why.

| Property | Type     | Description                                         |
| -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`   | `string` | What was left out, such as a field or an operation. |
| `reason` | `string` | Why, in a few words.                                |

### SpecOptions

Where an API description is, and its curation.

| Property    | Type     | Default                                        | Description                                              |
| ----------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `spec`      | `string` |                                                | A path or URL to an OpenAPI 2.0, 3.0 or 3.1 description. |
| `cwd?`      | `string` | `process.cwd()`                                | The project's root.                                      |
| `curation?` | `string` | 'curation.json' in the project's Uitive folder | The curation file; used when it exists.                  |

### Survey type

A compact inventory of an API description, to curate from: counts, advice, one line per source,
and what was skipped.

Uses: [`SurveySource`](#surveysource).

| Property     | Type                                                    | Description                                                                   |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title`      | `string`                                                | The API's title.                                                              |
| `version`    | `string`                                                | The API's version.                                                            |
| `server`     | `string`                                                | The base URL requests go to.                                                  |
| `counts`     | `{ sources: number; actions: number; skipped: number }` | How many sources and actions it yields, and how many operations were skipped. |
| `advice`     | `string[]`                                              | What to do next, such as curating a large description.                        |
| `sources`    | `SurveySource[]`                                        | One line per source.                                                          |
| `unattached` | `string[]`                                              | Actions on no source, such as `/v1/tokens`.                                   |
| `skipped`    | `Record<string, string[]>`                              | Skipped operations, by reason.                                                |

### SurveySource

One line of a survey: a source, its fields kept and left out, what its API can do, and its
actions.

| Property     | Type                                  | Description                                                     |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`         | `string`                              | The source's ID, as the curation names it.                      |
| `label`      | `string`                              | What people call it.                                            |
| `path`       | `string`                              | The path that lists its rows.                                   |
| `fields`     | `number`                              | Fields kept, and fields understood but left out.                |
| `extra`      | `number`                              | How many fields were understood but left out.                   |
| `names`      | `{ kept: string[]; extra: string[] }` | Their names, for the curation's `fields`, `labels` and `title`. |
| `filters`    | `string[]`                            | Fields the endpoint filters by.                                 |
| `search`     | `boolean`                             | Whether the endpoint searches text.                             |
| `sort`       | `string[]`                            | Fields the endpoint sorts by.                                   |
| `pagination` | `string`                              | How the endpoint pages: `cursor`, `offset` or `none`.           |
| `item`       | `boolean`                             | Whether rows can be read one by key.                            |
| `actions`    | `string[]`                            | The IDs of the actions on its rows.                             |
| `notes`      | `string[]`                            | Guesses worth checking against the running API.                 |
| `included?`  | `boolean`                             | Whether the curation keeps it, when there is one.               |

## Native blocks

Source: [`blocks.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/blocks.ts)

### BLOCKS

Where `generate blocks` writes, in a project that keeps Uitive's files in `uitive/`; commands use the project's own folder (`folderOf`).

```ts
const BLOCKS = 'uitive/blocks.generated.ts';
```

### emitBlocks

Writes blocks as a module of block specs, ready to spread into a contract's `blocks`.

```ts
function emitBlocks(blocks: readonly ComponentBlock[], core?: string): string;
```

Uses: [`ComponentBlock`](#componentblock).

### generateBlocks

Generates block specs from components' TypeScript props and writes them, or reports drift with
`check`.

```ts
function generateBlocks(options: GenerateBlocksOptions): Promise<{
  file: string;
  written: boolean;
  drift: boolean;
  blocks: {
    name: string;
    component: string;
    props: string[];
    adapter: string[];
  }[];
  problems: string[];
}>;
```

Uses: [`GenerateBlocksOptions`](#generateblocksoptions).

### readBlocks

Reads `file#Export` specifiers into blocks, with the project's compiler settings.

```ts
function readBlocks(specifiers: readonly string[], cwd: string): BlocksResult;
```

Uses: [`BlocksResult`](#blocksresult).

### BlockProp

One prop of a component, as a block's schema holds it.

| Property      | Type     | Description                                                                         |
| ------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`        | `string` | The prop's name.                                                                    |
| `schema`      | `string` | The zod schema, as code.                                                            |
| `description` | `string` | What the prop is, from its JSDoc.                                                   |
| `fallback?`   | `string` | The component's default, when it has one: the planner must now always give a value. |

### BlocksResult

What reading components gives: the blocks, and the components that couldn't become one.

Uses: [`ComponentBlock`](#componentblock).

| Property   | Type               | Description                                                     |
| ---------- | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `blocks`   | `ComponentBlock[]` | Each component, as a block.                                     |
| `problems` | `string[]`         | Components whose props can't become a schema: fix or wrap them. |

### ComponentBlock

A component read as a block: where it lives, what it is called, and its props.

Uses: [`BlockProp`](#blockprop).

| Property      | Type                                 | Description                                                |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`        | `string`                             | The block's name in the contract, such as `orderSummary`.  |
| `component`   | `string`                             | The component's export name.                               |
| `file`        | `string`                             | The file it comes from.                                    |
| `label`       | `string`                             | What people call it.                                       |
| `description` | `string`                             | What it shows, for people and models.                      |
| `props`       | `BlockProp[]`                        | The props a page may set, as data.                         |
| `adapter`     | `{ name: string; reason: string }[]` | Props an adapter supplies, such as callbacks and children. |

### GenerateBlocksOptions

What `generate blocks` takes: the components, where to write, and whether only to check.

| Property     | Type                | Default                                              | Description                                                 |
| ------------ | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `components` | `readonly string[]` |                                                      | `file#Component` for each component.                        |
| `cwd?`       | `string`            | `process.cwd()`                                      | The project's root.                                         |
| `out?`       | `string`            | 'blocks.generated.ts' in the project's Uitive folder | Where to write.                                             |
| `check?`     | `boolean`           |                                                      | Reports whether the file is up to date, without writing it. |

## Discovering an application

Source: [`discover.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/discover.ts)

### discover

Crawls a running application's pages, same origin only, following links but never pressing
anything, and proposes routes, regions, lists and button-to-action matches from what assistive
technology sees. Rows are never read.

```ts
function discover(options: DiscoverOptions): Promise<DiscoverResult>;
```

Uses: [`DiscoverOptions`](#discoveroptions), [`DiscoverResult`](#discoverresult).

### DISCOVERY

Where `discover` writes, in a project that keeps Uitive's files in `uitive/`; commands use the project's own folder (`folderOf`).

```ts
const DISCOVERY = 'uitive/discovery.json';
```

### DiscoverOptions

What `discover` takes: where the application runs, how much to crawl, and where to write.

| Property        | Type      | Default                                         | Description                                                      |
| --------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `url`           | `string`  |                                                 | Where to start, such as `http://localhost:5173/`.                |
| `cwd?`          | `string`  | `process.cwd()`                                 | The project's root.                                              |
| `pages?`        | `number`  | `30`                                            | Most pages visited.                                              |
| `perRoute?`     | `number`  | `2`                                             | Most visits per route, such as two orders.                       |
| `storageState?` | `string`  |                                                 | A Playwright storage state file holding a signed-in session.     |
| `chrome?`       | `boolean` | `false`                                         | Uses the installed Chrome instead of Playwright's Chromium.      |
| `out?`          | `string`  | 'discovery.json' in the project's Uitive folder | Where to write the discovery.                                    |
| `contract?`     | `string`  | 'contract.ts' in the project's Uitive folder    | Matches buttons against this contract's actions, when it exists. |

### DiscoverResult

What `discover` did: where it wrote, the pages it visited, and the discovery.

Uses: [`Discovery`](adapter.md#discovery).

| Property    | Type        | Description                      |
| ----------- | ----------- | -------------------------------- |
| `file`      | `string`    | Where the discovery was written. |
| `visited`   | `string[]`  | The URLs visited, in order.      |
| `discovery` | `Discovery` | What the pages suggest.          |

## Checking

Source: [`check.ts`](../../packages/cli/src/check.ts)

### BINDINGS

Where the bindings are, in a project that keeps Uitive's files in `uitive/`; commands use the project's own folder (`folderOf`).

```ts
const BINDINGS = 'uitive/bindings.ts';
```

### check

Checks an integration: the contract loads and validates, its JSON round-trips, every schema a
request can need fits structured outputs, labels find what they name, and bindings exist for
what the contract declares.

```ts
function check(options?: CheckOptions): Promise<CheckResult>;
```

Uses: [`CheckOptions`](#checkoptions), [`CheckResult`](#checkresult).

### checkText

A check's result as text, one line per check, with coverage and warnings.

```ts
function checkText(result: CheckResult): string;
```

Uses: [`CheckResult`](#checkresult).

### CONTRACT

Where the contract is, in a project that keeps Uitive's files in `uitive/`; commands use the project's own folder (`folderOf`).

```ts
const CONTRACT = 'uitive/contract.ts';
```

### contractIn

The contract a module exports: `contract`, the default export, or the only contract.

```ts
function contractIn(module: Record<string, unknown>): AnyContract | undefined;
```

Uses: [`AnyContract`](core.md#anycontract).

### loadModule

Loads a TypeScript module from the project, as the project would, tsconfig `paths` included.

```ts
function loadModule(path: string): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
```

### SCHEMA_LIMITS

What one request's schema may hold, so Claude's structured outputs accept it.

```ts
const SCHEMA_LIMITS: {
  readonly bytes: 60000;
  readonly optional: 0;
  readonly unions: 1;
  readonly enum: 400;
};
```

### Check type

One check: its name, whether it passed, and what it found.

| Property | Type      | Description                                             |
| -------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`   | `string`  | The check: `contract`, `json`, `schemas` or `bindings`. |
| `ok`     | `boolean` | Whether it passed.                                      |
| `detail` | `string`  | What it found, or what to fix.                          |

### CheckOptions

What `check` reads: the project, and where its contract and bindings are when they aren't in the
Uitive folder.

| Property    | Type     | Default                                      | Description          |
| ----------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| `cwd?`      | `string` | `process.cwd()`                              | The project's root.  |
| `contract?` | `string` | 'contract.ts' in the project's Uitive folder | The contract module. |
| `bindings?` | `string` | 'bindings.ts' in the project's Uitive folder | The bindings module. |

### CheckResult

What `check` found: whether the integration holds, each check, warnings, and coverage.

Uses: [`Check`](#check-type), [`Coverage`](#coverage).

| Property    | Type       | Description                              |
| ----------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `ok`        | `boolean`  | Whether every check passed.              |
| `checks`    | `Check[]`  | Each check, in order.                    |
| `warnings`  | `string[]` | Worth fixing, but nothing breaks.        |
| `coverage?` | `Coverage` | What the contract covers, once it loads. |

### Coverage

How much of the application the contract covers: sources, actions, routes, pages, regions, lists
and choices.

| Property   | Type      | Description                                                                 |
| ---------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sources`  | `number`  | Sources declared.                                                           |
| `actions`  | `number`  | Actions declared.                                                           |
| `runnable` | `number`  | Actions with an effect, which run through `perform` after confirmation.     |
| `performs` | `boolean` | Whether the bindings export `perform`, which interface actions may use too. |
| `routes`   | `number`  | Routes declared.                                                            |
| `pages`    | `number`  | Pages people can redesign.                                                  |
| `regions`  | `number`  | Regions: parts of the application as it already is.                         |
| `lists`    | `number`  | Lists, such as toolbars and menus.                                          |
| `choices`  | `number`  | Choices, such as a theme.                                                   |
